name: qpdf-node-workspace
description: Workspace root for qpdf-node. The root package qpdf-node is staged from packages/node by scripts/package-root.mjs; its platform packages by scripts/package-platform.mjs.

scripts.build:wasm: emcmake cmake -S . -B build/wasm -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build/wasm --target qpdf_wasm
